triage.proposed_comment: The core request — showing individual matches with both decks and the result on /matchups/ — was implemented in commit 9ddc93d2 (May 2023). The /matchups/ page now shows a full match list via the personmatches partial with home deck, opponent, opponent's deck, and game result. The 'spy in the log to mark if a card was played' stretch goal was not implemented.

verify.final_comment: The core request — showing individual matches with both decks and the result on /matchups/ — was implemented in commit 9ddc93d2 (May 2023), which both switched the template to the richer personmatches partial (showing deck, opponent, opponent's deck, and game result) and enabled display by changing show_matches from hard-coded False to conditional on results being present. The optional stretch goal of inspecting MTGO logs to flag whether a queried card was actually played was not implemented.
